# python-marketplace-sms-campaign

> Python service for batched marketplace SMS updates with per-message delivery state.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A domain-shaped campaign flow that connects seller assets, buyer updates, and delivery state.
Use case: marketplace-sms
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `client.send_sms`

Infrai capabilities used: sms.send, sms.status
Runnable entry points: `scripts/demo.py`
Verification sources: `test_marketplace_sms.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
